That is the 09-16 falsifier, not the 09-16 mapping error. Do **not** map NQ=F +2.12% / XLK +0.98% onto this book as a substitute for that print — use the print.

The load-bearing event was **FOMC 09-16** (25 bp to 3.75–4.00%, hawkish SEP, Warsh). That binary is **printed (T−3)**. News Judge #1/#2/#3 (Dow worst week; Warsh JH hike-odds; yields vs IWM) are the **same rates/risk object**, already in 09-16/17/18 XLC −0.90/−0.58/−1.37. Count **one** rates object, and it is **stale**. **08-11/08-12 geo-oil cap does not fire:** Channel 1 oil is **down** 1–6% depending on the sleeve; CL=F **−5.94%**. Morningstar 09-21: global stocks rally, yields lower, oil extends falls. Residual Hormuz is a carried overhang, not a same-morning down mandate.

Asia **+1.04%** and Europe **+0.95%** confirm the overlay. USD +0.08% 1d is noise. **S0 = +1.** One risk-on / oil-off / 1d-duration-relief object. Muse personal agent topping the US free App Store, Meta AI attaching to ad accounts / Advantage+ creative, and GOOGL Cloud/TPU plus Tigress PT **$485** are proof-adjacent, not pure narrative. **4. Breadth / leadership.** Independent of leftover 1d rel (09-11): META and GOOGL are **both** bid; NFLX ~flat-red; DIS ~+0.7%; telecom flat. MAP HEAT parent-adjacent groups print dir=up (Internet Content, Entertainment, Advertising, Gaming) with **low-weight captains** (RUM +11% compute, TTWO, APP, SPHR) that **do not average into XLC**. Mega-cap **is** the sector thesis — this is not “ETF up, names flat.” It is also not broad %-names expansion. Per 09-10/09-11: do **not** score S2=+1 as a second copy of the same two-name bid already in S1/S4, and do **not** map NQ vs ES. **S2 = 0.** Large-cap leadership is context, not an extra +1.

Washout-into-easing-macro can be reflex-bounce fuel — that is already in S0/S4; do not also score S3+. **S3 = 0.**

No pending CPI/NFP/FOMC binary this morning (News Judge RULES_APPLIED: none). ASML EUV / FIX / LITE are **XLK/SOX**, 08-27-forbidden.
